sentences.text:
Tejendranath Mandal vs The State Of West Bengal And Others
on 19 September, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 D/L41 C.R.R.759 of 2023
19.09.2023
Bpg.
In Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973;
Tejendranath Mandal Versus The State of West Bengal and others Mr. Sabir Ahmed.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee, Ld.P.P. Mr. Koushik Kundu.
Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.

Records of the present revisional application and CRR 760 of 2023 reflect that there are two cases,
one being Sonarpur Police Station Case No.322 of 2020 and another being Sonarpur Police Station Case No.821 of 2021.

entities.text: Sonarpur Police Station Case No.322 of 2020
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Sonarpur Police Station Case No.821 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: So far as the present case is concerned which relates to Sonarpur Police Station Case No.322 of 2020, the Investigating Agency submitted charge-sheet against the petitioner along with others.

Records of the revisional application also reflect that prior to the present case Sonarpur Police Station Case No.1474 of 2018 was registered for investigation under Sections 498A/323/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code Having regard to the contentions advanced by the petitioner, I am of the view that the revisional application is required to be heard out on merits.

Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party nos.2 and 3 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.
List the revisional application under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of January, 2024.

Pending hearing of the revisional application, further proceedings of Sonarpur Police Station Case No.322 of 2020 before the learned ACJM, Baruipur, South 24-Parganas be stayed till 31st January,
Tejendranath Mandal vs The State Of West Bengal And Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22107916/
1 2024.
Let the case diaries of Sonarpur Police Station Case No.1474 of 2018, Sonarpur Police Station Case No.322 of 2020 and Sonarpur Police Station Case No.821 of 2021 be produced before this Court by the State on the next date so fixed for hearing.
